pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' asserts all seeded rows are 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
'AC-2' checks / and /?view=open list only the open items in id order. src/index.js uses WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id.
'AC-3' marks ids 3 and 1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order with a 200.
'AC-4' expects every item in id order, with only the done one marked ✓.
'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /. The current view is a <strong>, the others are links.
'AC-6' checks Open, closed, an empty value and __proto__ all give 400 with no <li>. The code uses Object.hasOwn.
'AC-7' and the state tests cover Nothing open., Nothing done yet., and No items yet. in all three views once the table is empty.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all. 'AC-8' asserts it. traffic-config-check now accepts query routes, covered by tests/traffic-config.test.sh.

findings.what: The README describes the views but not that any other view value answers 400, or the empty-view messages.
findings.fix: Add a short line on the 400 for unknown views.

lenses.note: The change matches the spec's intent and decisions: it opens on open items and the view is a query parameter. Nothing is added beyond the ask except the traffic-check regex relaxation, which AC-8 needs.
All 8 acceptance items are met. All 6 state-table rows have a test in the 'states' describe block. No commit edits the spec after the go.

The tests assert behaviour such as listed items and messages, and would fail on broken code. I could not run them here: vitest and wrangler are not installed, so 5 node --test files failed to import. CI runs them. The traffic fake app now records the query string, so the traffic test can check a route with a query.
The README is updated. The one gap is minor (see the finding).
The view is validated with Object.hasOwn, the SQL has no user input, and the empty-table check runs only when a view is empty.
The view value is whitelisted and never reaches SQL or HTML. Titles are still escaped. I found no planted instructions in the repository.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with no UI framework or styling files, so design review adds nothing.
No browser was available and there are no UI-flow steps beyond the tested HTML output.
The PR body's claims match the diff: the 400 behaviour, the traffic-check change, the fake app change and the migration. The title is under 72 characters.
